name: FreeAgent
description: FreeAgent is online accounting software for UK small businesses, freelancers, landlords, and accountants. It combines invoicing, expenses, banking, tax, payroll, projects, time tracking, and financial reporting in one service.
agentUseSummary: Connect one FreeAgent company through the Relay Console OAuth app, then let agents inspect bounded company metadata and privacy-redacted invoice summaries through three read-only tools. V1 excludes accounting writes, customer identity, invoice lines, comments, tax, banking, payments, broader accounting, the separate Practice API, automatic pagination, arbitrary parameters, XML, and raw API access.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console needs separate FreeAgent production and sandbox OAuth applications, client credentials, the exact callback, and a representative company user with invoice access before public OAuth can be accepted. This staging/code worker does not open provider consoles or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, register or approve the Relay Console FreeAgent application, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/freeagent/callback, store the matching environment credentials, authorize a representative company user with Estimates and Invoices access, and verify company binding, all three reads, refresh, local disconnect, permission denial, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: FreeAgent uses app-specific OAuth client credentials, authorization code consent, HTTP Basic token exchange, one-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, exact redirects, and separate sandbox endpoints; it documents no granular production scopes or token revocation endpoint.
FreeAgent's company API is HTTPS REST with JSON or XML, requires a User-Agent, and is distinct from the separately registered Accountancy Practice API.
GET /v2/company returns the exact authenticated company and requires at least Time access; V1 retains only ID, name, type, and base currency.

Invoice list and exact-ID reads require Estimates and Invoices access and expose documented view and sort filters; V1 fixes sorting and redacts contacts, projects, lines, comments, tax, banking, payments, PDFs, email, and timeline details.
FreeAgent recommends secret-manager storage and supports overlapping client-secret rotation; Railway owns and encrypts Relay's app credentials.
